newsitem.title: UK: IBCA cuts Interbail's long-term rating to A.
newsitem.headline: IBCA cuts Interbail's long-term rating to A.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Wednesday it had downgraded Socit Financire d'Interbail's (Interbail) long-term rating to A from A plus.
Interbail is one of the major real estate leasing companies in France, IBCA said in a statement.
"Owing to the deterioration of the French economy, Interbail, in common with its peers, has suffered from a sharp decrease in new business," IBCA said.

This, it said, was increasing pressure on interest margins on new business, a historically significant level of loan loss provisions on Interbail's real estate leasing portfolio and persistently high vacancy rates on its own properties.
"These factors have led to a sharp drop in Interbail's operating profitability over the past two years," IBCA said.
IBCA said that Interbail's hidden reserves, in the form of unrealised capital gains, had also dwindled owing to the disposals it has made and the slump in French real estate prices.

"Although its capitalratios have decreased in recent years, Interbail, like many other real-estate leasing companies, continues to enjoy strong capitalisation," it said. "However the persistent pressure on its profitability and the continuing bleak outlook for the real estate leasing sector have led us to lower our Long-term rating."
